properties.sfomuseum:description: Handwritten letter from Harold M. Bixby to his wife, Debby Bixby, dated July 31, [1947], on stationery from the Imperial Hotel in Tokyo; includes update on air route contract; mentions General Douglas A. MacArthur, Major General White, and Vice Air Marshall Baucher.
